summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching the forms of its 4.657% Senior Notes due 2031 and 5.089% Senior Notes due 2036, along related legal opinions and consents, and incorporating these exhibits by reference into its existing Form F-3 shelf registration statement. The filing is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf — a standard capital markets transaction with no special-situation elements such as M&A, activism, restructuring, or a going-private event. Terms: two fixed-rate tranches, senior unsecured, tenors to 2031/2036, with Japanese withholding tax legend. None of the special-situation categories apply.
